classification.difficultyReason: Apply the distance formula to labelled endpoints, including horizontal and vertical intervals.

content.prompt: Find the distance between the labelled points in each diagram. Give exact answers and, where needed, approximations to 2 decimal places.

spec.description: Unnumbered Cartesian axes with arrowheads, endpoint coordinate labels and a descending segment. Decorative source red endpoints and blue segment use ordinary black ink; the origin numeral is omitted under the graph convention.
spec.mathematics: Endpoints (2,4) and (3,1); no grid or numbered ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied endpoints and joining segment are visible.

spec.description: Unnumbered Cartesian axes with arrowheads and a horizontal interval crossing the y-axis. Decorative source colours use ordinary black ink; the origin numeral is omitted under the graph convention.
spec.mathematics: Endpoints (-1,2) and (3,2); no grid or numbered ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied endpoints and joining segment are visible.

spec.description: Unnumbered Cartesian axes with arrowheads and a vertical interval crossing the x-axis to the right of the y-axis. Decorative source colours use ordinary black ink; the origin numeral is omitted under the graph convention.
spec.mathematics: Endpoints (2,3) and (2,-4); no grid or numbered ticks.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied endpoints and joining segment are visible.
